d:
Sanvidhan divas ke mauke par Bihar Congress ne Patna men sanvidhan raksha march nikala. pradesh adhyaksh Rajesh Ram ke netritv men nikle is march men nirdaliy sansad Pappu Yadav bhi shamil hue. hath men sanvidhan ki kitab lekar pahunche Pappu Yadav ne BJP par nishana sadha aur ise loktantr bachane ki laraee bataya.
March ke dauran kangres karyakartaon ne 'vot chori' ke aaropon ko lekar pradarshan kiya. R Block ke pas pulis bairikeding torkar karyakarta aage barhe aur BJP karyalay ke bahar bhi narebaji ki.
